Dear [Mr Innes](/person/744),
Votes coming straight to me, and votes going first to [Miss Coleridge](/person/329) made a certain amount of confusion - and four for Rowling Manor dated Jany 30th, came in just at the end and carried it up to 14 votes while L’Epine Noble has twelve --- So I suppose it must be the prize one, though my own judgment would not have gone that way.[^2]
Thank you about the stamps - We will divide

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: Black-edged paper.
[^2]: This relates to the prize for the best story in the Christmas 1891 number of the [MP](/periodical/52).

Readers were asked to vote for their favourite.
